description: Final integration pass: ensure all CSS class names from every TSX component are defined, fix any missing styles, verify the build compiles cleanly, and confirm no references to deleted tokens/variables remain.
steps: Run 'npx tsc -b --noEmit' in frontend/ and fix any TypeScript errors introduced by the changes.
Run 'npx vite build' in frontend/ and fix any CSS/build errors.

Grep all TSX files for className references and cross-check against the new CSS files. Add any missing class definitions. Key areas to check: owner pages (owner.css classes), PDF viewer (pdf.css classes), auth page classes (.auth-*), notification panel (.notif-*), bottom nav (.bottom-nav-*), global search, all dashboard page-specific classes.

Check that all CSS custom properties (variables) used in CSS files are defined in tokens.css. Search for var(--) usage and verify each variable exists. Common ones to verify: --bg, --surface-1/2/3, --text, --text-muted, --text-subtle, --border, --border-strong, --accent, --accent-soft, --accent-hover, --gold, --gold-soft, --success, --warning, --danger, --info, --shadow-sm/md/lg, --sp-1 through --sp-8, --radius-sm/md/lg/xl/full, --fs-sm/base/lg/xl/2xl/3xl, --font-sans, --font-mono, --duration-fast/base/slow, --sidebar-w, --topbar-h.

Verify that theme toggle still works: the ThemeToggle component uses data-theme attribute which is set via useThemeStore. The CSS must have [data-theme='dark'] and [data-theme='light'] selectors that override --bg, --surface-*, --text-*, --border, --shadow-* etc.
Ensure the inline theme script in index.html still works with the new CSS structure (reads localStorage 'madarek-theme' and sets data-theme attribute before paint).

Verify responsive breakpoints are present in the CSS: 375px (mobile), 768px (tablet), 1024px (desktop), 1440px (large). Key responsive rules: sidebar hides on mobile, grids collapse, font sizes adjust, topbar adapts.
Add @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) rule in reset.css that sets all animation-duration and transition-duration to 0.01ms.
Ensure all buttons have accessible sizing (min 38px touch target), all interactive elements have :focus-visible styles, all text has sufficient contrast ratios against backgrounds.
acceptance_criteria: npx tsc -b --noEmit passes with zero errors
No undefined CSS custom properties (all var(--x) have corresponding definitions)
Responsive breakpoints for 375px, 768px, 1024px, 1440px exist in CSS
Theme toggle works (both dark and light selectors have complete variable overrides)
No references to deleted files (stitch-tokens.css, landing-pro.css, etc) remain in any file
verification: Grep all TSX/CSS files for 'stitch-tokens\|landing-pro\|stitch-canonical\|elevation\|polish\|interactions\|premium' - should return zero results (old file references gone)
Grep CSS files for 'color-mix' - should return zero results
Grep CSS files for 'Lexend\|Outfit' - should return zero results
findings: All 83+ missing CSS classes added to pages.css. Responsive breakpoints for 375px and 1440px added to layout.css (768px and 1024px already existed). prefers-reduced-motion already present in reset.css. Theme toggle verified working (both dark/light selectors have complete variable overrides in tokens.css). No color-mix() usage, no Lexend/Outfit references, no old deleted file imports remain. CSS bracket balance verified for both modified files. TypeScript build and vite build cannot be run because node_modules is missing and INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network prevents npm install (consistent with FEAT-001/002 findings). All verification that could be done statically passes.
